SELECT
  C.CategoryName AS category,
  SUM(OD.Quantity) AS quantity
FROM Categories AS C
JOIN Products AS P
  ON C.CategoryID = P.CategoryID
JOIN "Order Details" AS OD
  ON P.ProductID = OD.ProductID
JOIN Orders AS O
  ON OD.OrderID = O.OrderID
WHERE
  O.OrderDate BETWEEN '1997-06-01' AND '1997-08-31'
GROUP BY
  C.CategoryName
ORDER BY
  quantity DESC
LIMIT 1;

sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(OrderTotal), 2)
FROM (
    SELECT
        T1.OrderID,
        SUM(T2.UnitPrice * T2.Quantity * (1 - T2.Discount)) AS OrderTotal
    FROM Orders AS T1
    INNER JOIN "Order Details" AS T2
        ON T1.OrderID = T2.OrderID
    WHERE
        T1.OrderDate BETWEEN '1997-12-01' AND '1997-12-31'
    GROUP BY
        T1.OrderID
) AS SubQuery;

sql:
SELECT
  T1.ProductName AS product,
  SUM(T2.UnitPrice * T2.Quantity * (
    1 - T2.Discount
  )) AS revenue
FROM Products AS T1
INNER JOIN "Order Details" AS T2
  ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID
GROUP BY
  T1.ProductName
ORDER BY
  revenue DESC
LIMIT 3;
explanation: The top 3 products by total revenue all-time were identified by aggregating sales data from the Products and Order Details tables based on the specified revenue calculation.

sql:
SELECT
  C.CompanyName AS customer,
  SUM(OD.Quantity * OD.UnitPrice * (
    1 - OD.Discount - 0.70
  )) AS margin
FROM Customers AS C
JOIN Orders AS O
  ON C.CustomerID = O.CustomerID
JOIN "Order Details" AS OD
  ON O.OrderID = OD.OrderID
WHERE
  STRFTIME('%Y', O.OrderDate) = '1997'
GROUP BY
  C.CompanyName
ORDER BY
  margin DESC
LIMIT 1;
